_: THE FILM AS DATA. Every shot is a plate plus a list of layers; a layer is a sprite, a
position and a named motion. Nothing here is a picture that has to be regenerated, so a
note from a reviewer is an edit to a number in this file and a re-render that costs
`carry` is the one structural idea. A carry group binds two geese, a stick and a hanging
character so the stick's endpoints ARE the geese's beak tips, computed from the sprite
manifest, and the hanging character's mouth IS the stick's midpoint. The geese cannot let
go of the stick because there is no state in which they are not holding it -- that was the
one fault four rounds of prompting never fixed.
`seg` names the narration clip the shot is cut to, so the film re-times itself when a line
is re-recorded. Shots sharing a seg split its duration between them.
